confidence_note: Design-material weight only. Not a measurement. A later note is not a match to a set-aside, and a sleep-onset gain on one task is not a yield.
hypothesis: A sealed return class can be hashed without storing a match sentence or a solved incubation.

sources.note: Lacaux et al., Science Advances 2021: at least 15 seconds in N1 was associated with more hidden-rule discoveries on one number-reduction task than wake; the association was absent in N2. Not a match between a morning note and a set-aside.
Sio and Ormerod, Psychological Bulletin 2009: an incubation break can help some problems; forgetting fixation is a leading account. A break is not itself a solution.

Sanders, Beeman, and Paller, Journal of Cognitive Psychology 2021: overnight sound cues interacted with fixating information on unsolved puzzles. Authors inferred processing beyond simple forgetting. Not a match score.
